Name: Game Speed Toggle
Author: Netherender5
Description:
[i]Features

[/i][list]
[*][b]Toggle between default speed and your custom speed[/b] using a single keybind.
[*][b]Fully configurable speed multiplier[/b] from [b]0.1× to 5×[/b].
[*]Adjusts [b]all time‑related systems[/b], including:
[list]
[*]Player movement
[*]NPC movement
[*]Animations (including in cutscenes)
[*]Time itself
[*]Fishing minigame (optional — can be excluded in config)
[/list][*][b]Instant switching[/b] — no fade, no delay, no reload.
[*][b]Configurable via [/b]config.json
or [b]in‑game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿[/b] (if installed).[*][b]Global settings[/b] (per‑save settings planned for a future update).
[/list][i]Compatibility[/i]

[list]
[*]Requires [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ support[/b] included (optional).
[*]Currently [b]singleplayer only[/b] — multiplayer support is planned.
[*]Works with many time‑altering mods, including:
[list]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/169]TimeSpeed[/url]﻿[/i]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]﻿[/i] (time cheats)
[/list][*]If you use other time‑altering mods, results may vary depending on load order and how they modify the game clock.
[/list][i]Configuration
﻿[/i]All settings are stored in config.json and can be edited manually or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:
[list]
[*][b]Toggle Key[/b] — choose any key to switch speeds.
[*][b]Custom Speed[/b] — set your preferred multiplier (0.1–5.0).
[*][b]Affect Fishing Minigame[/b] — enable/disable speed changes during fishing minigame.
[/list][i]Reporting Issues[/i]
﻿I’ve tested the core gameplay loops, but edge cases may still need more testing. If you encounter bugs, strange behavior, or conflicts with other time‑altering ﻿mods, [b]please leave a comment or report it[/b] so I can fix it.

Manifest.Name: GameSpeedToggle
Manifest.Description: Toggle custom game speed with a keybind (supports speeding up and slowing down).
